measured: 0 deaths in every hero-hour played (3,748 h): in band, 10 levels under, even with no armour. Food and regen cover 80-100% of damage taken.
target: Normal <=1 death per 1,000 h; Hard 10-30; Extreme 50-100
proposal: Monster damage x1.25 or x1.5 still gives 0 deaths. A level-gap attack boost (+8% per level under the floor) does create deaths; needs 100 h+ per cell before a number.
decides: Designer; the 2 s food cooldown is Tyler's

measured: A party of four earns 0.86x a member's best solo XP on party grounds (1.03x at full density).
proposal: Per-hero XP bonus 1 + 0.055 x (heroes - 1): full-density four goes 1.03x to 1.20x.

measured: On the new curve (pace brackets, lane/b-level-curve): 8 styles reach L10 in 5.9 h, L25 in 36.4 h, L50 in 173.2 h (median; the 10-19 curve at the same rates: 1 / 11 / 104 h). Past L50 at the ground contract (1086 x L^1.333 XP/h): L100 579, L200 1,737, L500 6,486, L1000 22,709 h.
proposal: Shipped: every target within 3.5% (tests/level-curve.mjs pins it). New grounds past L50 must pay the contract.
decides: Done (layer 1); grounds past L50 are the designer's

measured: No obtainable upgrade from L30 to L50+; 175 of 245 gear rows have no source; nothing above tier 3.
XP/h is capped by the ground's respawn: a weapon tier adds +0-4% (+5-8% only at full density).
proposal: No change yet; upgrades only show at full density.

measured: Higher grounds and party grounds are strictly better for a solo (L8 Sewer 62k XP/h vs Thicket 25k). The Warrens is Easy and profitable solo from about L41.
proposal: Recommendation honours the Warrens' solo level, set to about L40.

measured: Hammer and Mage top 29 of 30 in-band groups; tank, sword and healer last in 27. Default bars skip most rune spells.
A full tier cuts damage per swing 13-46%; one plate body piece 6%. With no armour in band: 0 deaths, -2 to -20% profit.
proposal: Leave until death risk (D2) gives armour a job.

measured: Unblessed death mid-Level: L10 0.14 h, L50 1.32 h, L100 5.15 h, L200 6.17 h, L500 10.93 h. From L86 a mid-Level death's 2% of total XP is more than the Level's own progress, so the never-de-level floor decides it (at most one Level's hours).
A hero's weapon skill on the new curve: 18 at L10, 32 at L25, 50 at L49 (median style). The skill curve was fitted to keep skill near Level through L25.
proposal: Skills run a little ahead of Level early; no change in this layer.

measured: Today's solo grounds in band: mill 7,719 at L4.5, meadowbrook 24,638 at L10, mosslight 75,765 at L23.5, coppercap 179,121 at L47.5 Level XP/h = 1086 x L^1.333.
proposal: A new ground must pay about 1086 x L^1.333 Level XP/h at its Level (L75 342,994, L150 864,091) or the hours past L50 drift.

measured: A lone hero stays in the Glade from L16 to L50 (the Warrens is a party ground): one Level takes 3.5 h at L31 and 9.8 h at L49 on the curve, 4.2 h at L50 at the contract rate.
proposal: D5 (a solo ground or the Warrens' solo Level for 32-50) shortens L32-50; re-measure the pace when it lands.

measured: The Hearth's fuel rate (FLAME_FUEL) was fitted to Inner Flame 15 by L25 at the old pace (12 h). On the new curve 12 h of hunting is Level 11.
Blessings are free below L30: 50 h of hunting now, 19 h on the old curve. Blessing, stamina-refill and rename prices scale with Level, so they take a smaller share of the gold earned by a Level.
